reason: I've drunk the same energy drink for years and I know exactly how it hits me on a late study night. I'm not swapping that for an unsweetened mate that I expect to taste like bitter grass tea, right before exams.
objection: Unsweetened yerba mate sounds bitter, and I don't know whether 80 mg from mate will actually keep me sharp the way my usual drink does.
would_change_my_mind: Tasting a free can at a café or the gym and finding it actually tastes good and keeps me focused through a long evening.
